gloss: service entrance; side door; staff entrance

definitions.gloss: service entrance; side door; staff entrance; back entrance
definitions.explanation: A secondary entrance to a building, typically used by staff, deliveries, or for everyday access rather than the main entrance.

examples.japanese: {通用口|つうようぐち}から{入|はい}ってください。
examples.english: Please enter through the service entrance.

examples.japanese: {配達|はいたつ}は{通用口|つうようぐち}を{使|つか}ってください。
examples.english: Please use the service entrance for deliveries.

examples.japanese: {正面|しょうめん}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}は{閉|し}まっていたので、{通用口|つうようぐち}から{建物|たてもの}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: The front entrance was closed, so I entered the building through the side door.

notes:
A compound of {通用|つうよう} (general use, common use) + {口|ぐち} (entrance, opening). Refers to a door used for everyday or practical access, as opposed to the formal main entrance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通用口|つうようぐち}から{入|はい}る: to enter through the service entrance
- {通用口|つうようぐち}を{使|つか}う: to use the service entrance
- {裏|うら}の{通用口|つうようぐち}: the back service entrance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正面玄関|しょうめんげんかん}: main entrance — the formal front entrance of a building
- {裏口|うらぐち}: back door — a door at the rear, sometimes with connotations of doing things secretly
- {非常口|ひじょうぐち}: emergency exit — used only in emergencies
